activity_summary: In the shop you began to explain a knot while Richard was tying a bundle. He told you it would be quicker if you stopped describing it. He tied it himself. He said the skins were in and the money was not. You opened no bill and bought nothing.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Began an explanation and did not open a bill.

entities.name: Richard Shakespeare
entities.context: Tied the bundle and ended the advice.

quotes.speaker: richard_shakespeare
quotes.text: It would be quicker if you stopped describing the knot.

quotes.speaker: richard_shakespeare
quotes.text: The skins are in. The money isn't. Same as always.
